tools.name: content_pack
tools.description: $0.07 USDC. Five social posts, three hooks, a caption, and hashtags.

tools.name: search
tools.description: $0.01 USDC. One web search. Not charged if search fails or finds nothing.

tools.name: research_pack
tools.description: $0.02 USDC. Up to 3 searches and 8 snippet sources. Not charged if nothing usable comes back.

tools.name: offer_normalize
tools.description: $0.01 USDC. Normalize up to three pasted offers. No URL is fetched.

tools.name: claim_audit
tools.description: $0.01 USDC. Check claims against excerpts you supply. No page is fetched.

tools.name: invoice_check
tools.description: $0.01 USDC. Check a supplied invoice. Unknown amounts are not treated as zero.

tools.name: quote_invoice_check
tools.description: $0.01 USDC. Compare a supplied quote or purchase order with a later invoice, line by line. Flags quantity, unit price, missing and extra lines, tax, and total mismatches. Text is untrusted and is not fetched. Not accounting or legal advice.

tools.name: vendor_check
tools.description: $0.01 USDC. Public-data counterparty brief: RDAP registration, DNS, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, an optional OFAC SDN match for a payee address, and the TLS certificate or Certificate Transparency. Domains only. Not a security audit or a full KYB guarantee.

tools.name: pay_to_check
tools.description: $0.005 USDC. Pay-To Safety Check. Send a URL, an EVM address, or both, plus an optional expected price and network. Returns safe, caution, or avoid with reasons and a score. Compares live 402 terms with Coinbase Bazaar prices, checks RDAP domain age, screens the OFAC SDN address list, and sees wheth

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: $0.003 USDC. Email Check. Send one email address. Checks syntax, MX records, a disposable-domain list, and the domain's SPF and DMARC. It does not send mail and it does not open an SMTP connection.

tools.name: fx
tools.description: $0.003 USDC. Currency conversion from cached ECB euro foreign-exchange reference rates. Optional VAT or sales-tax math uses a rate you supply or a country's standard VAT rate. Not a tax filing and not a tradable quote.

tools.name: company_facts
tools.description: $0.005 USDC. SEC EDGAR company facts for a US ticker or CIK. Returns the entity name and a short set of latest annual figures, such as revenue and net income, when the filing has them. Not investment advice.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: $0.003 USDC. Fetch one public http or https URL and return readable markdown. Private, loopback, and link-local addresses are refused, and the download is size-capped. Not a browser and not a signed-in session.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pay_to_check, email_check, page_to_markdown · Private data: email_check, page_to_markdown · Public sink: pay_to_check, email_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pay_to_check, email_check, page_to_markdown · Private data: email_check, page_to_markdown · Public sink: pay_to_check, email_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "$0.02 USDC. One web search. Not charged if search fails or finds nothing." → after: "$0.01 USDC. One web search. Not charged if search fails or finds nothing."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
